messages:
kai: Heads up — booking UK-edge A100s for client demo at 18:00 UTC. Can someone confirm we have quota in uk-edge zone and which cost center to charge? cc @elaine @matt

elaine: On it. I see 4 free A100 slots in uk-edge-prod pool but 2 already reserved by bookings. Which size do you need? p3 -> 2x A100 each?

kai: Need 3 gpus (single tenant), low-latency; prefer dedicated pool, not spot. If not, we'll fallback to eu-west1. Also need telemetry tag: project=demo-redwood, cc=platform-sdks

matt: I can free one slot by bumping a nightly canary off, but need approval from @ops-bot or @billing. @ops-bot can you confirm?

ops-bot: Canary bump approved for 1 slot if less than 2h notice. Billing: need cost center string. Provide in PR comment.

kai: Thanks. Cost center: 'PLATFORM-SDKS-Demo'. I'll add to PR. @elaine can you add the telemetry label to the terraform module? snippet: tags = { project = "demo-redwood" cc = "PLATFORM-SDKS-Demo" }

elaine: Yep will add. Also FYI vendor DM: vendor says potential latency with cross-zone NVLink on uk-edge racks; if we need <10ms we should keep in-zone. no cross-zone fallback.

kai: Noted — keep in uk-edge if quota ok. If not, fallback to eu-west with higher latency.

jasper: Quick note: if you pin model variant to quantized h4, it reduces footprint, could fit into 2 GPUs — might avoid bumping canary.

kai: Good idea. Let's test 2x h4 before bumping canary. I'll kick a quick smoke in 10m and post results here.

elaine: I'll prepare terraform PR and tag @matt for review. PR: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/terraform/pull/842

matt: LGTM — will review in ~20m. If urgent ping me directly.

kai: Test done: single-host 2x h4 pass for smoke (latency ~85ms). Ok to proceed with 2 GPUs in uk-edge. Moving to reserve.

elaine: Reserving now. Reserved slot id: rsv-uk-2091. Adding labels in PR.

ops-bot: Reservation created by elaine. rsv-uk-2091. Note: invoice code required on allocation: 'PLATFORM-SDKS-Demo'.

kai: :thumbsup: Thanks all. I'll update runbook and onboarding for demo team. Leaving this thread.
